Proposition
[Matched parameters and Type II rate (36.34)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0344, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0345 ↗ def:chow-iv-parabolic-leading-mode ↗ def:chow-iv-intermediate-profile ↗ def:chow-iv-tip-ansatz ↗ prop:chow-iv-outer-profile 1. ch36:36.34\group Matched Asymptotics

Matching the regional profiles forces $k\ge 3$ to be an arbitrary integer, $c(t)=c$ constant, \[ b_k=-\tfrac 12c^{-k},\qquad a=\frac{k(n-1)}{2c}, \qquad \Gamma (\tau )=e^{(1-1/k)\tau }. \] The resulting approximate solution has curvature blow-up \[ \sup _{x\in S^{n+1}}|\Rm (x,t)|\sim C(T-t)^{-2+2/k}, \] which is Type II for every $k\ge 3$.
